devtoPublish.reason: Reviewed 2026-08-12: git-push race condition in state persistence identified and fixed (fetch+rebase+retry before push, matching the pattern already used elsewhere in this repo). Script's own reconcileState()/reconcileOneAfter422() cross-references the live Dev.to API before every publish attempt, so retries cannot create duplicates even if a push still failed. Enabled by explicit owner request (Nermin Sefic) to clear a 149-item backlog.
